content.short: Base Bridge is the official gateway for transferring assets between Ethereum and the Base Layer 2 network.
content.description: Base Bridge is the critical infrastructure component that connects the Ethereum mainnet with Base, a secure and low-cost Layer 2 network developed by Coinbase. It provides a trustless and permissionless environment for users to move ETH and other supported ERC-20 tokens between the two networks, utilizing the underlying security of the OP Stack. The bridge features an intuitive interface designed for both individual users and developers, facilitating the flow of liquidity and assets into the burgeoning Base ecosystem. By ensuring fast and reliable cross-chain transfers, the Base Bridge acts as the primary onboarding ramp for the next generation of decentralized applications and users entering the Base network.
content.meta: Base Bridge is the official cross-chain gateway for securely transferring ETH and ERC-20 tokens between the Ethereum mainnet and the Base Layer 2 network.
